description_en: Queries the whitelist configurations of a listener
description_zh: 查询监听的白名单配置
name: DescribeListenerAccessControlAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can query the region ID from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html list or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域。

您可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html列表或通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

This parameter is required if the same port is specified for listeners of different protocols
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。

相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填
parameters.name: listener_protocol

AccessControlStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the whitelist is enabled. Valid values:

open_white_list: the whitelist is enabled.

close: the whitelist is disabled
AccessControlStatus.description_zh:
是否开启访问控制。取值：

open_white_list：开启白名单访问控制功能。

close：关闭访问控制功能
